capabilities.outcome: Let the in-editor Claude or Codex agent run independent read-only or preparation tasks in parallel helper sessions and use their reports
capabilities.authority: Host tool agent_delegate in desktop chat only. Helpers share the project lease, use the same provider and model, read and prepare through a fixed allowlist, and cannot create proposals, record feedback, change the timeline, approve or delegate. Local models do not delegate.

capabilities.outcome: Let the agent author motion graphics and sounds as code, optionally declare creator controls, actors and holds, and keep an append-only audit trail with the creator's review rating; save a creator's own graphic with its linked sounds to their personal Library and reuse it in other projects
capabilities.authority: Agent preparation: writes composition and sound source under hyperframes/<id>/ and sounds/<id>/, renders candidates, and appends audit events. Never edits the timeline, approves or exports; the proposal that places the result is the human review point, where the creator may rate the motion. Library tools write only the personal Library (save) or prepare renders in the target project (use); placing still goes through a proposal.
capabilities.acceptance: Controls file optional and never coverage-gated; declared controls the code ignores fail check; equal source, values and seed give identical sound bytes; every check and render appends audit events; project-health reports per-item revisions, edits, missed controls and ratings.

capabilities.outcome: Break supplied footage into a planned storyboard of beats and shots, with visuals shown over shots, that the creator reviews and tunes; and a planning canvas joining marked moments, effects and text that the agent reads to assemble
capabilities.authority: Writes only the freeform storyboard and its planning canvas, on the creator's request, as one revision-checked Undo step; shots reference original source windows; no cuts, timeline writes, generation or approval. Build timeline stays a human action.
capabilities.acceptance: A draft from a talking take saves as one Undo step with beats, notes, text, transitions and visuals over shots; stale revisions, unknown or unprepared sources, out-of-range windows, audio shots or visuals, and visuals outside or overlapping within their shot are refused without changing the board; an open Storyboard page adopts the new revision; Build timeline keeps each talking window one continuous clip with visuals on the lane above. Canvas writes add marked moments with notes, effect and text cards and the lines between them as one Undo step; unknown cards, bad ranges and stale revisions are refused without changing the board; storyboard_get returns the canvas as a resolved graph.
search_aliases: put the transcript in the script

capabilities.outcome: Recreate a reference video with other people: the reference split into beats at its cuts, a cast with photos, who appears in each beat, per-beat prices, and generated takes the creator chooses as each beat's footage
capabilities.authority: Writes only the Follow-reference storyboard plan, on the creator's request, as one revision-checked Undo step, and quotes prices for free. Generation spends credits only from the creator's Recast click in the Storyboard; choosing a take, Build timeline and approval stay human actions.
capabilities.acceptance: A plan without beats splits the reference at its shot cuts and saves as one Undo step with cast and per-beat people; unknown cast names, non-photo cast sources, overlapping or out-of-range beats and stale revisions are refused without changing the board; quotes pad short beats to the model's minimum window; a chosen take is kept in the Library and becomes the beat's selected footage trimmed back to the beat.

capabilities.outcome: Find library sound effects and prepare a cue-specific audition: picture, speech and audio context, peak-aligned leveled candidates with ready create_audio operations, and a loudness-alignment image; measure on-screen activity curves (from keyframes, presets, composition scene data or decoded frames) so sounds follow the picture, and verify a sound's alignment numerically; split a reference's sound effects into single spectrally isolated units with measured character and leakage, and rebuild units as tunable synth sounds
capabilities.authority: Read-only catalog, timeline, proposal and media reads; never edits the timeline. visual_activity_prepare runs agent-written activity_js over a composition's local scene data in an isolated VM only for trusted local requests. sound_units_extract starts the shared stem separation for a project source, writes a rebuildable cache under analysis/sound-units/, imports units as managed project media (never tracked catalogs: reference audio is cleared for that project only) and writes rebuilt sounds through the sound-synth renderer. Placement happens through proposal_create, where the creator listens and chooses.
capabilities.acceptance: Ranking respects role, query, duration and audibility; each candidate's measured peak lands on the cue; speech basis is reported; operations validate in proposal_create; the image is returned as MCP image content. Activity curves land on the timeline clock through trims and speed; the sound-sync eval separates curve-driven sounds from single-cue placements. Sound units carry less foreign energy than equal-span time cuts, named events keep their own unit, identical calls reuse the cached result, rebuilt sounds report their spectral fit and respond to every declared control.

capabilities.outcome: Choose where DreamCut keeps projects and move existing projects into the creator's DreamCut Library
capabilities.authority: Creates a Library only in an empty folder and saves the creator's choice; moves only the projects the creator confirmed from a shown plan; never deletes, merges or overwrites projects; no timeline edits.
capabilities.acceptance: A new Library is created at the suggested or chosen folder; an existing one is chosen; a migration plan lists projects and sizes; only confirmed projects move (rename on one disk, verified copy keeping originals across disks); conflicts are skipped; a newer Library is refused.

capabilities.outcome: Open the local DreamCut editor for the creator from their coding agent, and keep a GitHub install up to date
capabilities.authority: Starts the local editor bound to 127.0.0.1 and returns a single-use, short-lived browser sign-in link; no project, timeline or file changes. dreamcut_update apply fast-forwards a clean GitHub install to the public repository's default branch only after the creator agreed, reinstalls dependencies when the lockfile changed and restarts the editor in place; it never merges, stashes or discards local work and refuses development checkouts, forks and packaged installs.
capabilities.acceptance: The editor starts or is reused; the link signs a browser in once and expires; requests without the session, with a foreign Host or Origin, or cross-site are refused. A clean install behind GitHub reports the commits and fast-forwards; a dirty, diverged or off-branch copy, a development checkout and a fork are refused unchanged.

capabilities.outcome: Split a drawing into native, separately editable shape pieces that draw on
capabilities.authority: Compiles create_shape operations only; no timeline writes; proposal_create and human review remain required.
capabilities.acceptance: Pieces land where they were drawn, pass the proposal operation schema, draw in order, and keep each piece within shape limits; invalid SVG fails with a reason.

editor_agent_contract: Each capability states whether the in-editor agent gets its MCP tools. The editor session's families and the harness operator allowlist are derived from these fields; coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) use the same MCP server. See docs/standards/agent-surface-parity.md.
